description: USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE FACTORY OF object-class-name-1 (ISO §2023:13.18.60.2; GR22 d)1.a./d)2.a.) — the item holds a class's FACTORY object, not an instance. LIVE since kb/Work PB389 (it was loud-staged COBOL0899 before): the emitted type is the D11 factory singleton class, INVOKE through it resolves the FACTORY method interface (§2023:9.3.6), SET … TO class-name is §2023:14.9.39.3 SR13, and SR12 a)3. makes the FACTORY axis invariant on assignment.
